# A quiet notebook your AI agent can read

Lumen Notes keeps every note as a plain markdown file on your own disk. It syncs those files between your laptop, your phone and your tablet, and it can publish any notebook as a small website.

## Why plain files

Plain files outlive applications. A folder of markdown opens in any editor, searches with any tool and diffs cleanly under version control.

### Built for agents as well as people

Every published notebook ships with an llms.txt index, a markdown twin of each page and structured data in the page head.

### Sync without surprises

Sync runs over an end-to-end encrypted channel. Conflicts are kept side by side as two files instead of being merged silently.

## Getting started

Download the app for your system, point it at a folder and start writing. [Read the install guide](https://good.example/docs/install) or [compare the plans](https://good.example/pricing).
